name: Scene revision
purpose: Re-renders one scene (plus transition padding) and splices it into the existing visuals at exact frame boundaries, then re-muxes. Keeps the previous track.
capabilities: verifies frame counts and reports the measured change outside the range

compatibility.notes: Re-encodes the picture track once: outside pixels are visually but not bit-identical (measured 0.09/255 mean).

licensing.notes: Internal workspace component; no third-party code copied.

approval_evidence: Exercised in tests/test-creative-intelligence.py (54 tests) and on three demonstration projects on the M2 host (2026-11-02). Experimental: not promoted to approved because that requires a render-host evidence trail over more than one session.
